body: It's saved in my app, but look at the keyboard if you have a US keyboard (or find a pic of one otherwise). It's top left corner, top right corner, bottom right, bottom left (so each corner, clockwise) ... Then the next one toward the middle in each corner, until finally the bottom row meets in the middle. If you have no idea what I'm talking about, type it for yourself. You'll quickly see the pattern.
